s.note: Cheese, crackers, grapes and pickled onions on a tray for the flight deck.
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into cubes. Thread cubes onto toothpicks with a green grape and a cocktail onion. Lay them out in neat rows on a tray beside a row of crackers, like an old airline snack service.

s.note: Cooked prawns on iceberg with a tomato and horseradish cocktail sauce.
s.how: Peel 600g cooked prawns, leaving a few tails on. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Worcestershire. Shred half an iceberg lettuce into 4 glasses, pile in the prawns, spoon over the sauce and hang a prawn and a lemon wedge on each rim.

m.note: Seared sirloin in peppercorn cream, mashed potato and steamed green beans.
m.how: Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Crush 1 tbsp peppercorns into the pan, add 250ml cream and reduce until thick. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Serve on trays, airline style.

w.note: Baked cheesecake with sour cream, cut into little squares.
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a slab tin. Beat 750g cream cheese, 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight, cut into squares and top each with a cherry.

d.n: Wrong week to quit Black Russian
d.note: Vodka and coffee liqueur stirred over ice in short glasses.
d.how: Fill 4 short glasses with ice. Pour 160ml vodka and 80ml coffee liqueur over the ice, dividing evenly. Stir and finish each with 3 coffee beans.
